email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Customer Services Executive role at IWG. With a background in digital marketing and web development, I have spent my career helping people and businesses improve their online presence. I enjoy interacting with clients, solving problems, and making sure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage websites, communicate with clients, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. I am comfortable learning new systems quickly and applying them with confidence. My experience in customer-facing situations has taught me the importance of a warm welcome and a positive attitude.

I am fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have a good command of Dutch. I am outgoing, motivated, and eager to contribute to a dynamic team. I would love the opportunity to bring my can-do attitude to IWG and help customers have a great day at work.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing this role further.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Customer Services Executive position at IWG. Although my background is in digital marketing and web development, the core of my work has always been about people: understanding their needs, solving their problems, and ensuring they have a positive experience. I am confident that my communication skills, positive attitude, and eagerness to learn make me a strong fit for this role.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I interact with clients regularly, manage multiple projects, and handle a variety of tasks to keep websites running smoothly. I have learned to listen carefully, respond promptly, and adapt to new challenges. For example, I built and optimized websites for clients such as a youth chess champion and a pharmacists' association, where I had to understand their unique requirements and deliver results that met their expectations. These experiences have honed my ability to provide friendly and efficient service, even when working remotely.

What draws me to IWG is the emphasis on world-class customer service and the opportunity to be part of a dynamic, global team. I thrive in environments where I can interact with people, take direction, and continuously learn. I am fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have a good command of Dutch, which allows me to connect with a diverse range of customers. I am also a natural problem-solver, always looking for ways to improve processes and make things easier for others.

I am eager to bring my outgoing personality, can-do attitude, and determination to be my best every day to IWG. I am confident that I can help customers and colleagues have a great day at work, and I am excited about the career opportunities that IWG offers.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and mindset align with your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Fluent in English, native Turkish, and good Dutch – strong communication skills for interacting with diverse customers.

• Quick learner: self-taught in SEO, AI tools, and web development; comfortable picking up new systems.
• Motivated to grow: continuously seeking improvement and taking on new challenges with a can-do mindset.
